column3: measurement (CEO-1696: a program the oracle gives no output for, or whose answer is not known, is excluded with its measurement; hq_snobol4 2026-10-17, sbl -bf x64 4.0f, stdin family.csv, cwd the file's own directory)

sbl -bf refuses it (rc 231): ERROR 217 duplicate label at lines 4 and 5 -- its IMPORT family_prolog.* lines are the polyglot linkage of the scriptix family demo, which SPITBOL reads as three statements labelled IMPORT; the block prints nothing of its own and its answer is the three-language pipeline's (CONTAINERS.tsv LIBRARY row)

sbl -bf prints nothing (0 bytes, rc 0): -EXPORT/-IMPORT are control lines SPITBOL ignores and parse_csv is defined and never called; the answer the block exists for is family_net/family.ref, the SNOBOL4+Prolog+Icon pipeline of family_net/run.sh (a JVM-era link no single-language oracle runs; its Icon driver is demos/icon/EXCLUDED.tsv's demo/family_net/family_icon.icn)
